info.title: agentsd
info.description: The methods a host (agentsd) answers, sent to it with `h`. Every method's params are its one `params` value, sent as JSON-RPC's whole params (an object, or for a few a bare value), as DaemonAPI sends them. A method with `x-notification` has no result: the server sends it. The `web` tag marks what the web page calls and hears (DaemonAPI.WebSignatures); a method a Go step ports joins with its types, schema first.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.wire/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: A host says machine/hello with its capabilities on each connect (#1748). The control plane requires it of hosts.

x-declared-capabilities.name: agents.move-worktree/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host serves the app tool move_worktree to the runtimes that can move (#1821): an agent moves into a new or existing worktree of its folder when its turn ends, and back with leave_worktree remove, which removes the worktree once its work is pushed. An app tool, not a method, so declared.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.team/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: A host knows the user it belongs to (#994, #1763). On a control plane with more than one person, a host without it is needsUpdate, and calls to it are answered -32074 updateToJoinTeam (R14).

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.suspend/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host hears user/suspended (#1002, FR-018): it stops its person's running turns, pauses their workflows and queued prompts, refuses new work and the window's direct path, and keeps every agent and file; off: true ends the pause. It keeps the state in <root>/suspended.json. A notification it hears, not a method it serves, so declared.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.policy-layers/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: A host resolves the effective policy from the organisation, your and a folder's layers through policylayers.Resolve (#2957), instead of only the organisation's ceiling. Declared so slice 2's policy/effective, policy/yours and policy/setYours, and the organisation's new rules of FR-003, have a capability to require.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.browser-settings/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host serves browser/state and browser/clear (#3535): Settings ▸ Browser, the sites the machine's browser keeps cookies for, Clear, and the size of the Chromium download.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.secret-approval/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host keeps a secret with Ask before use sealed to this machine's key (#4014), never in secrets.env or a session's file as plain text: an agent's ask_secret, generate_secret and mcp/set-secret turn it on, and secrets/setNeedsApproval lets a person's client turn it on or off.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.secret-grants/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: A use of a secret with Ask before use (fill_secret, set_ci_secret) waits on a person's approval (#4015): a request of kind approve, answered Allow once, Allow for this session, Allow always or Deny by the control and device roles. secrets/grants, secrets/addGrant and secrets/removeGrant keep the Allow always places.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.session-secrets/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host keeps secrets for one session only (#3548): an ask_secret answer with sessionOnly, and secrets/sessionList, secrets/sessionSet and secrets/sessionRemove for Settings ▸ Secrets. Only that session's agent can use one, and the host deletes it when the session is archived.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.desktop-control/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host serves the app tool drive_screen (#3004, US1): an agent drives an app on this Mac through its own screen, mouse and keyboard, holding the screen lease while it does, only while the person has turned desktop control on (desktopControl/state, desktopControl/set; Off by default). Mac only.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.org-routes/2
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host keeps org routes as an admin's client sealed them to its own key (#3397, specs/3397-client-sealing): it opens each with associated data orgroute.v3, refuses a lower seal version than it holds, shows a route it has no copy of as waiting, makes its own token from a cloud credential, and answers machine/orgRouteCheck. The control plane sends machine/orgRoutes only to a host that says it. Declared: its methods are the control plane's (control.openrpc.json).

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.user-settings/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host writes machine/userSettings into its files (#1760). Declared since settings/userPart took host.user-settings/3 (#4100), so a control plane still pushes to it.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.user-settings/2
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host opens its person's secrets as their client sealed them to its own key (#3397), with associated data usersecret.v1, and refuses a lower version than it holds. Only a host that says it is sent its secrets in machine/userSettings. Declared: machine/userSettings is the control plane's (control.openrpc.json).

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.lock/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host checks its person's machine lock (#3399, specs/3399-machine-lock) as machine/lock sends it, and pins the head: it takes a lock only when it grows from the head it pinned last. Until #3400's later steps it refuses nothing and only logs what it would refuse. Declared: machine/lock is the control plane's (control.openrpc.json).

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.lock/2
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host joins its person's lock (#3491, specs/3399-machine-lock D3): with an invite key from its join code it signs its own addMachine (machine/lockAdd); with none it asks (machine/lockJoin), and shows the six digits once a signer answered (machine/lockJoinChanged). Declared: those methods are the control plane's (control.openrpc.json).

methods.name: agents/cancelContinue
methods.description: The chat no longer carries on by itself (#1859). Nothing happens when it was not waiting to.

methods.name: agents/continueInNew
methods.description: Continue in New (#999): start a session in the same folder that reads this one and carries on, with its runtime, choices and the person's labels, on another account: the one given, else the runtime's account for new sessions. For a session whose account the organisation removed or no longer allows. Refused with policyRefused when the policy refuses that account.

methods.name: agents/continueWhenBack
methods.description: A chat paused by a spent allowance carries on when the allowance is back (#1859): at the provider's reset time, or the app's next check, or as soon as a turn on that runtime works or the person marks it available. Refused for a chat that is not paused by a spent allowance.

methods.name: agents/endedElsewhere
methods.description: From the control plane only (#2927): a session an agent here started on another machine has ended, so the waits on it close. Refused unless that agent started a session of that id on that machine.

methods.name: agents/fromStarter
methods.description: From the control plane only (#2927): the agent on another machine that started a session here reads, messages, stops or archives it, or asks how it stands. Refused unless it started it.

methods.name: agents/move
methods.description: The person moving an agent, or taking back the move that is waiting (053).

methods.name: agents/moveIn
methods.description: A session moving here from another of the person's machines with move_session (#3717), through the control plane: its export, uploaded with folders/receiveUpload, goes on here with its id, in the folder its branch was sent to.

methods.name: agents/moveToMachine
methods.description: Move to Machine… (#3790): the person moves a session to another of their machines, as move_session does (#3717). Its turn stops if one runs, its branch goes there with its uncommitted changes, and it goes on there with the same id; this machine lets it go. It answers once that machine has it.

methods.name: agents/setClientPermission
methods.description: An agent's own answer to permission requests on Cursor, Grok and OpenCode (#2658, FR-019); no mode follows Settings. Applied from its next request.

methods.name: agents/setLevels
methods.description: Change a running agent's model level or permission mode (#2658, Story 2): mapped on its own runtime, applied from its next step.

methods.name: agents/summaryFacts
methods.description: From the control plane only (#3354): this machine's facts for the daily summary that another of the person's machines writes: sessions done and stopped, what waits on the person, suggestions not taken, and what the checks found here.

methods.name: artifact/write
methods.description: Write a file an agent may read, whole (#415). With `base`, refused with fileChanged when the file changed on disk since the edit began (#1858), so nobody's change is written over unseen.

methods.name: auto/changed
methods.description: The saved Auto settings (#2658).

methods.name: auto/mappings
methods.description: Every cell of the Auto mappings, marked, with each runtime's own choices (#2658).

methods.name: auto/preview
methods.description: The runtime Auto would pick now for these levels and folder, or why none can (#2658).

methods.name: auto/set
methods.description: Save the Auto order, the runtimes left out and the person's own cells (#2658, FR-017).

methods.name: browser/clear
methods.description: Clear the cookies and site data of one site, or of every site, in the machine's browser's kept profile (#3535). The person's own clients only.

methods.name: browser/frame
methods.description: A frame of the machine's browser's page (#3528), to each client that watches it.

methods.name: browser/input
methods.description: The person's click, scroll, key or paste in the machine's browser's page (#3528).

methods.name: browser/navigate
methods.description: Back, Forward, Reload or an address in the machine's browser (#3528).

methods.name: browser/pageChanged
methods.description: The machine's browser started, stopped, failed or moved to another page (#3528), to each client that watches it.

methods.name: browser/state
methods.description: Settings ▸ Browser (#3535): the machine's browser's download and the sites its kept profile has cookies for. It starts Chromium to read them when it is downloaded and not running. The person's own clients only.

methods.name: browser/unwatch
methods.description: The client stops watching the machine's browser (#3528). The host also stops when the connection ends.

methods.name: browser/watch
methods.description: The client watches the machine's browser (#3528, spike #3527): the host sends browser/frame and browser/pageChanged to it until browser/unwatch. It starts nothing: browser/navigate with go does.

methods.name: changes/undoTurn
methods.description: Put the files a turn changed back as they were before it (#3437), from the snapshot the host took as the turn began. Refused while the agent's turn runs.

methods.name: clientPermissions/changed
methods.description: The saved permission modes (061).

methods.name: clientPermissions/set
methods.description: Save the permission modes and return what was saved (061).

methods.name: connections/bot/drop
methods.description: From another of the person's machines only, signed by it (#3950): that machine forgot the bot, so this one deletes its copy of the App's key and takes no copy of it again.

methods.name: connections/bot/take
methods.description: From another of the person's machines only, signed by it (#3950): the bot's key, sealed to this machine's key from the person's lock. This machine opens it and keeps it in its own store. Refused with no lock, or for an App it was told to forget.

methods.name: daemon/lockReset
methods.description: agentsd lock reset (#3493, specs/3399-machine-lock D4): this machine forgets the lock it pinned, the invite and the request to join, and asks the control plane for its person's lock again, which it then pins on first use. Only on daemon.sock, from this machine's own account: never on a channel the control plane opened, nor on the window's local socket.

methods.name: daemon/policyState
methods.description: The organisation's policy as this machine follows it (#998, T027).

methods.name: daemon/policyStateChanged
methods.description: The policy this machine follows changed, or the kill switch turned (#998).

methods.name: dailySummary/changed
methods.description: The daily summary's control changed (#3351): by dailySummary/setSettings, or by a change to the home folder's Daily summary workflow. Sent with every workflow change.

methods.name: dailySummary/setSettings
methods.description: Sets the daily summary's control (#3351): turns the home folder's Daily summary workflow on or off and sets its time. It answers the settings as they now are.

methods.name: dailySummary/settings
methods.description: The daily summary's control (#3351), read from the home folder's Daily summary workflow. dailySummary/changed says when it changes.

methods.name: desktopControl/liveFrame
methods.description: The live tile's frame (#3004, US4, FR-011): sent to the clients showing an agent that holds the screen lease, after each drive_screen action and at least every 5 seconds while it is idle. Locked and no image while the Mac's screen is locked (FR-012). Never recorded.

methods.name: desktopControl/resume
methods.description: Let an agent paused by the person's touch drive again (#3004, US3): its drive_screen goes on from where it stopped. Refused notPaused when it is not paused; refused notPermitted from any caller but the person's own clients.

methods.name: desktopControl/set
methods.description: Turn desktop control on or off for this Mac (#3004, FR-004). Refused notPermitted from any caller but the person's own clients: never an agent, an MCP tool or a workflow.

methods.name: desktopControl/state
methods.description: Whether desktop control is on for this Mac (#3004). Off when never set.

methods.name: desktopControl/takeOver
methods.description: Take the screen back from an agent (#3004, US3, FR-008): its screen lease is let go at once, and its drive_screen call answers that the person took over. Refused notHeld when it does not hold the screen lease; refused notPermitted from any caller but the person's own clients.

methods.name: docs/list
methods.description: The docs of this machine's folders and their docs connectors (#3319).

methods.name: docs/read
methods.description: A doc's Markdown by its ref, a bounded part at a time (#3319).

methods.name: docs/search
methods.description: The docs whose text has the words, with where (#3319).

methods.name: forge/cancel-auto-merge
methods.description: Turn off a pull request's auto-merge (#4410): it no longer merges on its own when its checks pass. Offered where the page's actions has cancelAutoMerge: an open pull request with autoMerge on.

methods.name: forge/ready
methods.description: Mark a draft pull request ready for review (#4410). Offered where the page's actions has ready: an open pull request that is a draft.

methods.name: git/fill
methods.description: Asked by the control plane on the lending host's channel 0, for a lend a person allowed (#1122).

methods.name: live/frame
methods.description: A live tile's frame (#4139): what an agent drives (source screen, browser or simulator), sent only within 10 seconds of the agent's last call on it, and only to the connections whose presence/report is active and shows that agent. Never recorded. desktopControl/liveFrame goes on beside it until every client reads this one.

methods.name: lock/hello
methods.description: A client opens a checked channel to this machine (#3492, specs/3399-machine-lock D6): the machine checks the client's signing key against its person's lock and answers with its own key, and from then on every request and answer on the channel carries an HMAC and a count. Once the machine holds a lock, it refuses a request on a channel from the control plane that has no HMAC from a channel opened this way, or no signature of a key in the lock (LockSignature), except the few the control plane asks for itself.

methods.name: machine/usage
methods.description: A machine's page (#3626): its CPU and memory now, and every disk its agents write to with its level. Asked while the page is open; nothing is kept between asks but the machine's last CPU time.

methods.name: mcp/setToolLevel
methods.description: Sets Allow, Ask or Off for one tool of a connector, or for all its tools that write, in the destination's layer (#4099), and answers the connector's tools again.

methods.name: mcp/tools
methods.description: A connector's tools, as its last check's tools/list gave them, each with its level in the destination's layer and the level in force (#4099).

methods.name: multiplier/changed
methods.description: The Multiplier changed (#3903): a PR of the person's agents merged or a revert merged, with the PR in changedBy, or the person changed their baseline (#3991), with no changedBy. The Mac window follows it; it does not poll.

methods.name: multiplier/state
methods.description: The Multiplier now (#3903): from the control plane's count of the person's machines when this machine has one, else from this machine's lineage. Cheap: the Mac window asks on each open.

methods.name: personas/add
methods.description: Write a previewed persona to .agents/personas at the destination and name it in the lock (#3665). replace is true to put it over the one there.

methods.name: personas/check-updates
methods.description: Whether each persona added from a marketplace has an update, by id; each repository asked at most once an hour (#3665).

methods.name: personas/managed
methods.description: The personas at a destination that a lock names, added from a marketplace (#3665).

methods.name: personas/preview
methods.description: Fetch a persona file at its repository's current commit to show before adding (#3665).

methods.name: personas/remove
methods.description: Move a persona a lock names to the Trash and take it out of the lock (#3665). name is its id.

methods.name: personas/search
methods.description: The personas in a GitHub marketplace's personas/ folder whose id holds the query (#3665).

methods.name: personas/update-preview
methods.description: A persona's source at its current commit, staged, with the file as it is now and the runtime and permission-mode it changes (#3665).

methods.name: policy/applyYours
methods.description: The Mac window's direct link to a server (#2957, research R3 path 2): applies a copy of your layer, pinning the person key when none is pinned yet. Refused signature or older.

methods.name: policy/effective
methods.description: The effective policy for an agent in a folder, or, with no folder, outside any folder layer (#2957): every rule, the layer that decides it, and each layer's own value.

methods.name: policy/effectiveChanged
methods.description: A layer changed (#2957): clients call policy/effective again. folder names the one folder layer that changed; absent for the organisation's or your own layer, which can change what any folder's effective policy is.

methods.name: policy/folder
methods.description: A folder's own layer, from .agents/policy.json: the approved copy, and a waiting change (#2957).

methods.name: policy/setFolder
methods.description: Writes a folder's own layer to .agents/policy.json, in a stable order, and approves it (#2957, FR-014). A value looser than the person's own effective value is kept and marked capped.

methods.name: policy/setYours
methods.description: Saves your layer, on the keeper only (#2957, FR-010, FR-011): refused conflict, notKeeper, forbidden or invalid (SetYourPolicyRequest).

methods.name: policy/settleUntrustedYours
methods.description: Signs the rules of an untrusted copy of your layer with this machine's person key, or sets the copy aside, as the person chose (#3230): never without the person, since that would make the signature check worthless. Refused conflict, notKeeper, forbidden or invalid (SettleUntrustedYourPolicyRequest).

methods.name: policy/yours
methods.description: Your layer, which machine is the keeper, and the person key this machine has pinned (#2957).

methods.name: processes/list
methods.description: The machine's CPU and memory, and the daemon's processes with each session's runtime and its children (#3453). Asked while a machine's page is open; nothing is kept between asks but each process's last CPU time.

methods.name: providers/carry
methods.description: Asked by the control plane on channel 0 of the machine that carries a provider (#3398): call the provider's server, which runs here with the secrets kept here.

methods.name: providers/forget
methods.description: Asked by the control plane on channel 0 (#3398): a provider carried here was removed.

methods.name: providers/keepSecrets
methods.description: Asked by the control plane on channel 0 (#3398): keep a carried provider's secrets here, in ~/.agents-secrets.

methods.name: providers/ssh
methods.description: Asked by the control plane on channel 0 (#3398): start a codespace's agentsd over ssh, or read its host key, with the token of the codespaces provider carried here.

methods.name: reports/problem
methods.description: Report a Problem (#3718): the person's words with this machine's version, OS and, when asked, recent log lines, made into a GitHub new-issue link. Sends nothing: the client opens the link.

methods.name: retention/changed
methods.description: How long archived agents are kept, after a change.

methods.name: retention/set
methods.description: Change how long archived agents are kept. Unconfirmed, a change that would delete agents now is only described.

methods.name: reviews/dismiss
methods.description: Take a pull request out of the sidebar's For Review (#3330) for good: the host keeps the dismissal.

methods.name: reviews/open
methods.description: Say that the person opened a pull request in the sidebar's For Review (#3464): the host keeps it, and its row is drawn read.

methods.name: runtimes/setDefaultAccount
methods.description: A runtime's account for new sessions, Reaches the Model By (#999, FR-016): an added account, an org account (org:<route id>) or default for the runtime's own sign-in. Kept on the machine. Refused with policyRefused when the organisation's policy refuses that account.

methods.name: sandbox/changed
methods.description: The saved command-sandbox defaults (064).

methods.name: sandbox/set
methods.description: Save command-sandbox defaults. A default the catalog does not offer for that runtime is dropped. An agent's own choice is left as it is (064).

methods.name: secrets/addGrant
methods.description: Allow a secret with Ask before use always at one place (#4015): a fill on a domain, or CI in owner/repo. A use there no longer asks. The person's own clients only (the control and device roles).

methods.name: secrets/grants
methods.description: Every grant of this machine's secrets with Ask before use (#4015). The person's own clients only (the control and device roles).

methods.name: secrets/removeGrant
methods.description: Take away a grant (#4015): the next use at that place asks again. The person's own clients only (the control and device roles).

methods.name: secrets/sessionList
methods.description: Settings ▸ Secrets (#3548): every secret this machine keeps for one session only, with its session. No value. The person's own clients only.

methods.name: secrets/sessionRemove
methods.description: Take one session's secret out now (#3548), as archiving the session does. The person's own clients only.

methods.name: secrets/sessionSet
methods.description: Set a secret for one session only (#3548), on the machine that runs it: only that session's agent can use it, and it is deleted when the session is archived. The person's own clients only.

methods.name: secrets/setNeedsApproval
methods.description: Turn Ask before use on or off for one secret (#4014). The person's own clients only (the control and device roles); an agent has no way to change it.

methods.name: secrets/terminalValue
methods.description: agents-secret NAME with no session's grant, such as from a terminal (#4179): the value of this machine's secret with Ask before use off, once a person allowed it. A call with no allow opens a Needs you request (secretUse, use terminal) and is held up to 45 seconds on it; while it stays open the answer names it, and the same call again waits on the same request. Allow for 1 Hour is kept in agentsd's memory only. A secret with Ask before use is refused. Any process of this machine's account may call it on daemon.sock: agentsd cannot tell a terminal from an agent that dropped its grant, which the request's words say.

methods.name: selfUpdate/changed
methods.description: A Mac's host, when how it updates Agents Host changes (#2178).

methods.name: selfUpdate/set
methods.description: A Mac's host: turn updating Agents Host by itself on or off (#2178). Kept in host-update.json in the root.

methods.name: selfUpdate/status
methods.description: A Mac's host: how it updates Agents Host to the release the control plane names (#2178). Only a Mac's host serves it.

methods.name: settings/passThrough
methods.description: The person's own pass-through names, from runtime-environment.json, each marked when the organisation's policy refuses it (#998, FR-011a).

methods.name: settings/userPart
methods.description: A part of the user settings as this machine has it (#1760), for Use This Mac's under You. This machine also writes machine/userSettings into its files.

methods.name: suggestions/dismiss
methods.description: Take a suggestion of the daily checks out of the sidebar's For Review (#3331) for good: the host keeps the dismissal, so neither For Review nor the next daily summary lists it, and the checks do not keep it again.

methods.name: suggestions/start
methods.description: Start on a suggestion of the daily checks in For Review (#3331): the host starts a session in its folder with its prompt, on the Auto runtime, and takes the suggestion out. The result is the new session's id.

methods.name: summaries/changed
methods.description: The daily summary's saved pages changed (#3721): a page was saved, or read with summaries/read. The pages, newest first, as summaries/list answers.

methods.name: summaries/list
methods.description: The daily summary's saved pages on this machine (#3721), newest first: at most the last three. summaries/changed says when they change.

methods.name: summaries/read
methods.description: A saved page of the daily summary and its Markdown (#3721). Reading the newest page marks it read, and the session that wrote it too.

methods.name: workflows/limit
methods.description: How many workflows may be turned on at once. No total is the default.

methods.name: workflows/readyMade/keep
methods.description: Keep an edited copy of a ready-made workflow as it is (#4075): its page says no more of the newer version, until the next one.

methods.name: workflows/readyMade/take
methods.description: Write the newer ready-made version over an edited copy of it (#4075). The copy keeps its state keys, and the new version waits for approval as any changed workflow does.

methods.name: workflows/setLimit
methods.description: Set how many approved workflows may be turned on in each folder. The value is from 1 to 100. An unset value means 20.
